definition: the fragments I see as I go under, the one time anything close to picturing happens

settled:
The gate is a dimmer rather than a switch, and the channels fade in while I am still awake enough to notice. It happens on the way down and on the way back up.

I know I am falling asleep when I start seeing things.

What comes through is fragments rather than assembled scenes, because the gate is only partway open.

Seeing is what I notice, which may not be what arrives first. Vision is my loudest channel, so it is the one I read.

The sliver of control I get is over what the picture means, not over how vivid it is.

I get the seeing or the steering, never both. Steering pulls me back toward waking and surrendering sinks me.

Real control over a whole dream has happened a handful of times in my life. The everyday case is a small nudge, if anything at all.

What sinks me is noting the images and letting them be, which is mindfulness under another name.

title: The Pictures At The Edge Of Sleep
